subtitle: Anime-style RPG Dungeon Crawler
loreSummary: Middara is an ultra-modern fantasy miniatures board game where you and up to three friends take on the role of adventurers in a deep, sprawling narrative.

completionist.name: Completionist
completionist.description: Includes side quests and optional encounters.

milestones.title: The Trial of the MAST
milestones.description: Venturing into the subterranean trials of the Acerbus with Nightingale, Zeke, Remi, and Rook to earn citizenship in Middara.

milestones.title: Shadows Over Elenia
milestones.description: Navigating the bustling streets of Elenia, uncovering dark political conspiracies, and facing rogue animus threats.

milestones.title: The Sunken Labyrinth
milestones.description: Delving into forgotten ruins and lost technology beneath Middara while hunted by deadly adversaries.

milestones.title: The Web of Deception
milestones.description: Unmasking the true mastermind orchestrating the crises across the realm and braving high-tier battlegrounds.

milestones.title: The Climax of Act 1
milestones.description: The decisive multi-phase confrontation to preserve the realm and conclude the epic first act of the campaign.
